question: 最近30天（2026年8月14日至9月12日）中，有哪些地区-分类组合的销售金额高于该地区各组合的平均销售金额？（请给出地区、分类与销售额，取前10）
gold_sql: WITH pair_sales AS (SELECT o.region, c.name AS cat_name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-14' AND o.order_date <= '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.id, c.name HAVING SUM(oi.subtotal) > 30000) SELECT ps.region, ps.cat_name, ROUND(ps.revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM pair_sales ps WHERE ps.revenue > (SELECT AVG(t.avg_rev) FROM (SELECT region, AVG(revenue) AS avg_rev FROM pair_sales GROUP BY region) t WHERE t.region = ps.region) ORDER BY ps.revenue DESC, ps.region, ps.cat_name LIMIT 10
pred_sql: WITH region_category_sales AS (SELECT o.region, c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.id), region_avg_sales AS (SELECT region, AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales FROM region_category_sales GROUP BY region) SELECT rcs.region, rcs.category_name, rcs.total_sales FROM region_category_sales rcs JOIN region_avg_sales ras ON rcs.region = ras.region WHERE rcs.total_sales > ras.avg_sales ORDER BY rcs.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10
